name: Email newsletter (Brevo)
note: Built for Brevo. Brevo requirements are from Brevo's documentation (2026-10-14); layout, spacing, hero and type values were approved by the brand team on 2026-10-16. Colours and type come from the design system only.

text_group.note: The least space between any two text elements.

banner_text_inset.note: Least distance from a heading on a banner to the banner's edges.

surfaces.note: Newsletter only. The email sits on background/secondary and the 600px content column on background/primary. The contrast is deliberately subtle: the content should read as a layer without standing out.

banner_heading.note: The heading sits on the banner.

hero.rule: Use only the elements the user gives; order and placement are the designer's call.
hero.live_text: Headings, subheaders and CTAs are live HTML text, not part of an image, so they read with images off.

banner_fallback.note: The banner cell's background colour shows when images are off and in Outlook desktop.

cta.build: Bulletproof button: a table cell with a link and live text, not an image.

typography.breakpoint_note: Desktop sizes at the 600px breakpoint, Mobile sizes at 400px.

hero_title.use: The main heading of the email, on or near the banner

subheader.use: The line under the hero title

step_down.note: If a long heading stays as the user wrote it, the hero title may step down one size to stay uncluttered; never below the minimum.

typography.font_note: Per the two-typefaces rule there is no third fallback: headings are TASA Orbiter falling back to Inter, body is Inter. Email clients that don't load web fonts will show their default font; this is accepted (brand team, 2026-10-14).

guardrails.note: Guidance for whoever designs in this format. user_decides = what is made (the user's call); fixed = do not change; must_not = hard limits; avoid = strong advice; design_direction = how to use the system; claude_decides = how it looks, where the designer has freedom. Every design item cites its basis in the design system.
user_decides: What is being made, for whom and why: the deliverable, its format, purpose and audience.
The content and facts. The designer uses exactly what the user supplies or approves: never invents, adds, rewrites, shortens or cuts it, and asks before suggesting a change.
The scope: which sections, pages or slides. Nothing is added that was not asked for; when it is unclear, ask.
Link and call-to-action destinations, and which Brevo contact attributes to personalise with.

fixed.text: Two breakpoints: 600px wide on desktop and 400px on mobile (used below 600px). Height follows the content.
24px padding left and right at both breakpoints, so content is 552px wide on desktop and 352px on mobile.
Brevo custom HTML: table-based layout with inline styles.
Set text with Role/* styles in the Newsletter mode: Desktop sizes at 600px, Mobile sizes at 400px.
Headings TASA Orbiter falling back to Inter; body Inter. No other fallback.
Logo centred at the top, as a retina PNG. Its image and link are placeholders the designers fill in.
Every image and link is a placeholder (IMAGE_URL_…, LINK_URL_…); the designers upload images and add links themselves. List every placeholder with its size at the end.

claude_decides: Layout and composition within the grid: what goes where, how many columns, what leads.
Visual hierarchy: what is large, what is quiet, and how the eye moves.
Which components to use and how to combine them, and new card designs on Card base when the named cards don't fit the content.
How to show each idea: a stat, a process, a comparison, a story.
How the requested content is grouped into sections, and in what order.

overrides.reason: Email clients render small text poorly.

platform.html: Custom HTML: table-based layout, inline styles, 600px max width, a media query switching to the 400px mobile layout below 600px

unsubscribe.use: href of an <a> link; mandatory in every campaign

mirror.use: href of a 'View in browser' link

contact_attribute.use: personalisation; ATTRIBUTE must match the Brevo contact attribute name exactly (case-sensitive), e.g. {{ contact.FIRSTNAME }}

platform.quotes_note: Use straight double quotes around placeholders (href="{{ unsubscribe }}"); typographic quotes break Brevo's template rendering.

placeholders.rule: Every image and link is a placeholder; designers upload the images and add the links themselves. Alt text comes from the user; when it has not been given, use ALT_TEXT_<NAME>. Placeholder images keep their final width and height and a container/secondary fill so the layout holds. List every placeholder, with its display size and upload size (2x), at the end.
placeholders.syntax_note: Placeholders are plain uppercase names, never Brevo {{ }} syntax: Brevo would treat them as variables. Only {{ unsubscribe }}, {{ mirror }} and {{ contact.ATTRIBUTE }} use it.

icons.note: Sizes in px at the design size. In a UI card the icon square follows the card: pick the step for the card's width, so a bigger card gets a bigger icon and square (CSS container queries on the card). The square is the icon plus 8px (gap/inline) on every side, a solid fill with no border; square only. Figma: the Icon square component (Size = icon size).
